about: Showcase records (the Highlights deck): the strongest sites of the nine governorates, each with a verified cover, a gallery, a historical background, two or more credible publishers and, where one exists, a verified map position, video or 3D resource. They lead public demonstrations. tests/showcase.test.mjs keeps every record at that standard; replace a record rather than lower it.

site-diyala-kifri-qaysari-bazaar.gallery: Only one free photograph of the bazaar exists on Wikimedia Commons (searched 2026-11-14); the other files show people or the wider town.
site-diyala-kifri-qaysari-bazaar.position: No published coordinates for the bazaar itself; Wikidata has no item for it, so no pin until a survey point is recorded.

site-anbar-norias-of-hit.position: The card covers waterwheels at Hit, Haditha, Anah and al-Qa‘im, so a single pin would misplace most of them; the town point of Hit is kept as an approximate area.
